findings.message: Resolved in fix round 1: a would-be done state now downgrades to planning whenever approval.implementation_ready is false. Regression fixtures cover a null digest with a missing plan and untracked marker/plan while stories and required retrospectives otherwise appear complete.

Resolved in fix round 1: pm-exec and plan Integration branch now use one Git-compatible validator that rejects @, double slash, trailing dot or .lock, @{, leading dash/dot components and forbidden characters while accepting valid slashed branch names.

summary: Independent re-review verified both T02 corrections, current/upstream state compatibility, strict story contract separation and bounded diagnostics. Both prior majors are resolved and fresh exact-snapshot gates passed.
